title: Sentry Hub Universal Script
features:
Sentry Hub, the best keyless universal script

Aimbot
- Enable / Disable
- Custom Keybind (keyboard and mouse)
- Target Part Selection
- Aimbot Method (Camera / Mouse)
- Aimbot Mode (Hold / Toggle)
- Smoothness Control
- FOV Control
- FOV Circle
- Wall Check
- Ignore Team

Hitbox Expander
- Enable / Disable
- Size Control

ESP
- Box ESP (2D / 3D)
- Tracer ESP
- Outline ESP
- Name ESP
- Distance ESP
- Skeleton ESP
- Health Bar ESP
- Health Text ESP
- Box ESP Type Selection
- Health Bar Border
- Health Text Style
- Team Check

ESP Colors
- FOV Circle Color
- FOV Thickness
- FOV Transparency
- FOV Filled
- Rainbow ESP
- Visibility ESP
- 2D Box Color
- 3D Box Color
- Tracer Color
- Outline Color
- Fill Color
- Name Color
- Distance Color
- Health Text Color
- Skeleton Color

Player
- Fly (Enable / Disable / Speed / Keybind)
- Noclip (Enable / Disable / Keybind)
- Infinite Jump
- Walk Speed
- Jump Power
- Spinbot

Misc
- Anti-AFK
- Anti-Fling
- Fullbright
- Field of View
- ESP On Self
- Sentry Hub Loader
- Rejoin
- Server Hop

Config
- Theme Color (changes all accent colors in the UI)
- Toggle Keybind (change the key to open/close the script)
- Notifications
- Destroy UI

Default Keybind: LeftAlt to open/close the script
